about: Plain hand copies of the Service's Hermes plugins that boxes got before the plugin entered this repo (issue 532). Each blob is the git blob id of a file at that path inside hermes-plugin/<name>/. Add a blob only after rebuilding its exact bytes from a shipped version and saying how in the note.
